# ShapeField { #timetoalign.ShapeField }

```python
ShapeField(raw=None, unit=None, number_type=None, *, source_fields=None)
```

The field of one kind of shape: every number on one declared axis.

Each number is stored as the number struct alone, both sides filled; the
unit and the number type are the field's metadata, as an
:class:`~timetoalign.core.time.IntervalField` holds them.

## Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [from_shapes](#timetoalign.ShapeField.from_shapes) | Build the field of *shapes*, in row order. |
| [x_max](#timetoalign.ShapeField.x_max) | Per row the shape's largest x, a number struct (null on a null row). |
| [x_min](#timetoalign.ShapeField.x_min) | Per row the shape's smallest x, a number struct (null on a null row). |

### from_shapes { #timetoalign.ShapeField.from_shapes }

```python
ShapeField.from_shapes(shapes, *, unit=None, number_type=None, name=None)
```

Build the field of *shapes*, in row order.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type                                                                                         | Description                                                           | Default    |
|-------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| shapes      | [Sequence](`collections.abc.Sequence`)\[[ShapeT](`timetoalign.core.events.ShapeT`) \| None\] | Shapes of the field's class (``None`` for a null row).                | _required_ |
| unit        | [TimeUnit](`timetoalign.core.enums.TimeUnit`) \| [str](`str`) \| None                        | The shapes' unit; required for an empty or all-null input.            | `None`     |
| number_type | [NumberType](`timetoalign.core.enums.NumberType`) \| [str](`str`) \| None                    | Their number type; required likewise.                                 | `None`     |
| name        | [str](`str`) \| None                                                                         | The field's name: ``bounding_box`` or ``quadrilateral`` when omitted. | `None`     |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                                                                             | Description   |
|--------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------------|
|        | [ShapeField](`timetoalign.core.events.ShapeField`)\[[ShapeT](`timetoalign.core.events.ShapeT`)\] | The field.    |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                                          |
|--------|----------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [TypeError](`TypeError`)   | If a shape is not of the field's class.                              |
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If the shapes lie on two axes, or an explicit axis contradicts them. |

### x_max { #timetoalign.ShapeField.x_max }

```python
ShapeField.x_max()
```

Per row the shape's largest x, a number struct (null on a null row).

### x_min { #timetoalign.ShapeField.x_min }

```python
ShapeField.x_min()
```

Per row the shape's smallest x, a number struct (null on a null row).
